sections.Profile:
Slap Stick , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in 1976, is a rare electro-mechanical pinball machine with only 85 units produced. Designed by Jim Patla and featuring artwork by Dick White, this machine includes four flippers, two pop bumpers, and various standup targets and kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Good Times, Carnival, Circus, Clowns, Horses, Original Theme, 1970s, Police, Animals, Single level playfield
